items.headline: Bears QB Williams unsure if he's playing, has to still go through protocols
items.description: Caleb Williams reached another milestone in his recovery from a hamstring injury, logging full participation in practice for the first time since Sept. 18.

items.headline: Bears and Falcons lean on run games but have endured stressful starts to the season at quarterback
items.description: — When Chicago Bears coach Ben Johnson said this week that “a lot of things have gone through our minds” about his quarterback depth chart, the Atlanta Falcons could relate.

items.headline: Williams returns to practice
items.description: Courtney Cronin details Caleb Williams' return and who could start at QB if Williams is unable to go in Week 6.

items.headline: Falcons QB Michael Penix on track to start vs. Bears if no setbacks, coach says
items.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will start Sunday against the Bears despite a rib injury, as long as there are no setbacks during the week.
